* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Agenda: rebellion. Adds one battle destiny with Leia. Your [Coruscant] senators and [Coruscant] Political Effects are lost. While at Senate: unique (•) Rebels of ability < 4 are power +2, and, if opponent just lost Force to a Force drain by a Rebel, may retrieve 1 Force.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) printed the same text (it drops the uniqueness dot).<ref name="cl-1250_34-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Bail Organa (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “if opponent just lost Force to a Force drain by a Rebel” to “if you just Force drained with a Rebel”. PC-E1 text: “Agenda: rebellion. Adds one battle destiny with Leia. Your [Coruscant] senators and [Coruscant] Political Effects are lost. While at Senate: unique (•) Rebels of ability < 4 are power +2, and, if you just Force drained with a Rebel, may retrieve 1 Force.”<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
